rapport_notes: Warm, personable tone throughout; genuine enthusiasm ('That's so exciting, congratulations') and humor ('I'm gonna start using that').
process_discipline_notes: Rep asks 'do you have any questions or concerns for me?' but does not hold silence—immediately launches into the drawer-packing explanation. Also, no silence held after 'does that all make sense?' before pivoting to move-time factors.

evidence_quotes.agenda: And then do you have any questions or concerns about the move that you would like specifically answered on this call today? — asked AFTER preliminary logistics questions (booking time, email confirmation, address, etc. had already started).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised only one concern ('1:00 time, we'd love it earlier')—rep acknowledged ('I know, it's too hot for that to do any after like ten') but did not probe deeper. No second layer of follow-up.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We do have our free evaluation coverage included in the hourly rate that provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace our reimburse for accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: You'll receive a meet your mover email introducing them to you helping ease detention or strangers arriving at your front door.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We do have our on time guarantee we value your time. So, we can't make it in the time window that we arrange. We immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.communication: They will call you the day before to confirm the move and then we will call you the or the afternoon and let you know when we are on the way.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: It looks like the system has you estimated at five hours. Obviously there are number of factors involved in determining move time.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_estimate_window: Obviously there are number of factors involved in determining move time.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: If you can consolidate things in the boxes and even if you have the ability to take some of the smaller things over yourself in a car Luter too. That would really help keep the time down in our efficiency up.
evidence_quotes.drawer_prep: They do prefer the drawers empty just for liability and we, you know, cause it's easier for them to move if it's lighter.
evidence_quotes.final_estimate: For your estimate for the five hours, that's 1185.

top_strength: Excellent rapport and natural warmth throughout; handled customer's prior-experience question smoothly and gave practical, specific guidance on drawer prep and self-packing to reduce move time.
coaching_note: Move 'Their agenda' question to the very start of the call (before any logistics probing), hold silence after open-ended questions, and add 'rate locks when you book' + explicit close ask ('Would you like to move forward with us?') at the end.
